mentions.name: whatsinmycloud.com
mentions.description: This tool scans an AWS account to identify wasted spend and security holes, then delivers ten prioritized fixes. It requires only read-only access (describe/list/get, no write permissions) and is currently free while feedback is gathered.
mentions.problem: More people are shipping to AWS without having spent years learning it, and AWS does a poor job of showing what is actually costing money or sitting wide open.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished dev on whatsinmycloud.com. It scans your AWS account, finds the wasted spend and security holes, and gives you ten prioritised fixes.
